why: Holiday match: a deep forest-green field like her backs, coral-red poinsettias like her pink and coral faces, and mint sprigs like her mint and teal layers.
Holiday match from her own brand: an emerald-and-teal plaid centre for her backs and layers, framed in hot pink roses and red bows.
Holiday match: a deep teal-green ground with pink fronds, coral-red blooms, teal flowers and mustard-gold leaves. Nearly every colour on her faces is on it.
Holiday match: a chartreuse centre like her bright layer, green gingham, pink-trimmed trees and a pink stripe inside the red border.
Holiday match: green and hot pink plaid with a pink wreath centre: her greens and her hot pink, dressed up for Christmas.
Holiday match: the simple one. A solid green gift with a pink ribbon and red bow, so her tiles and the hot pink rack do the talking.
Your pick to look at: pink chinoiserie with pink lotus, lime and leaf greens, like her pink lotus and green pagoda faces and her lime layer. The soft, pretty take: little forest green.
